probes.scenario: Given a new account 'a' When 10 is deposited into it Then the deposit is accepted and the balance is 10
Given account 'a' with balance 100 When 30 is withdrawn Then the withdrawal is accepted and the balance is 70
Given account 'a' with balance 0 When a deposit of -5 is attempted Then it is rejected and the balance stays 0
Given account 'a' with balance 100 and account 'b' with balance 0 When 30 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' Then it is accepted, 'a' has 70 and 'b' has 30
Given account 'a' with balance 100 When 50 is transferred from 'a' to 'a' Then the transfer is rejected
Given account 'a' When 100 is deposited (t1) and 30 withdrawn (t2), both accepted Then the history of 'a' holds exactly those two operations, t1 then t2
Given account 'a' When a deposit of 10 with transaction id 't1' is sent twice (a retry) Then the balance is 10 and the history holds one entry
